basis: US dollars per million tokens, on the four disjoint counts of a usage record: input (neither read from nor written to a cache), cache_read, cache_write and output. A harness that reports input including the cached part has to subtract it before the record is written (the Codex adapter does). A model is listed under every id a harness may report it by (claude-haiku-4-5 and its dated id are separate entries with the same prices). cache_write is the 5-minute write price; a harness that charges nothing extra for cache writes (OpenAI) has it equal to input.
